result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a sidewalk on only one side of the street, with the opposite side consisting of an unpaved vacant lot. The roadway lacks marked crossings, lane markings, or traffic calming measures, and the pavement surface shows significant signs of degradation. Parked vehicles along the curb further restrict the effective roadway width and create visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven dirt.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street opposite the houses

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, presenting trip hazards for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb block sight lines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the street to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces, improving safety for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic calming, and utility poles obstruct the narrow walkways.

hazards.name: Utility poles on sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow walking path on the left sidewalk, creating obstacles for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a large white truck, obstruct the view between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and reduce the distance pedestrians must cross.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly designate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other measures to ensure vehicles maintain safe, low speeds in this residential zone.

result.summary: This is a narrow, one-way residential street lined with row houses and mature trees. While sidewalks are provided on both sides, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or mid-block crossing infrastructure forces pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without priority.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Adding curb extensions at intersections would reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implementing speed humps would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow sidewalk adjacent to a large vacant lot, lacking any buffer from the roadway. There is a complete absence of pedestrian-scale infrastructure such as lighting, marked crossings, or traffic calming measures, resulting in a desolate and exposed walking experience.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights to illuminate the walkway for nighttime safety.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large vacant lot provides no active surveillance or interest, making the environment feel isolated.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no physical or horizontal separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase physical separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and naturally slow traffic.
